positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for development, vulnerability compliance and AWS support. 
• Contribute to an application team via development and scripting (python)
• Manage and resolve vulnerability and compliance findings
• Architect AWS solutions and support

positions.title: DevOps Engineer - Senior Associate
positions.description:
Responsible for developing infrastructure as code utilizing AWS. 
•  Collaborate with application and IPS teams to develop cloud solutions for Capital One applications.
•  Develop Chef cookbooks, roles, and environments for automated application deployments.
•  Develop CFTs and terraform scripts for AWS infrastructure deployments.
•  Develop CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins
